subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw suppress OptimizationGuide/WasmTts model downloads by default for managed and sandbox headless Chromium launches, or keep this as operator-controlled launch-arg behavior?
rationale: The code change is small, but the default policy depends on live current-Chrome behavior and on whether OpenClaw should hard-code upstream Chrome feature flags instead of relying on `browser.extraArgs` and custom sandbox entrypoints.

options.title: Prove then add default suppression
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Keep operator control
options.body: Leave defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add explicit config only if needed
options.body: Introduce a dedicated suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing launch-arg surface is insufficient and worth the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Prove then add default suppression
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest browser launch ownership history and already reviewed the stale attempted fix.
